# netskopebwan_controller (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# A single object is addressed either by its id...
data "netskopebwan_controller" "by_id" {
  id = "6501f0c2e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6"
}

# ...or by a filter, which has to match exactly one object.
data "netskopebwan_controller" "by_filter" {
  filter = "name eq \"example\""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Filter selecting the object to read, in the API's filter syntax, e.g. `name eq "corporate"`. It has to match exactly one object. Exactly one of `id` or `filter` is required.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object to read. Exactly one of `id` or `filter` is required.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--created_by))
- `generation` (Number) Generation
- `modified_at` (String)
- `modified_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modified_by))
- `operator_nrn` (String) Operator NRN
- `overlay_id` (Number) Overlay ID
- `overlay_ip` (String) Overlay IP
- `overlay_pubkey` (String) Overlay public key
- `provision` (Boolean) Indicates if the controller is provisioned
- `public_ipv4` (String) Ip Address of the VPN Peer.
- `replicas` (Number) Number of replicas for the controller
- `resource_request` (Attributes) Resource request for the controller (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_request))
- `version` (String) Version of the controller
